messages:
marta: Heads up — support flagged dedicated customer billing weirdness. fncall schema rejects are being counted against the generic /chat.generate quota in the console.

noah: ugh. any example req ids?

marta: req id 2f9b8c4a at 2026-03-14T16:02:11Z. validator returned error 'invalid_function_output' (expected object, got array). console shows tokens on /chat.generate and quota incremented there.

tia: quick read on the pipeline: ingress -> auth -> stream-router -> validation -> exec -> billing. we moved stream-router decision later for streaming optimizations, so validation runs before route metadata is present. default route is /chat.generate so early failures pick that.

noah: options: A) move route decision earlier (bigger risk), B) populate an x-route-hint header at ingress with the resolved route and have validator respect it (low-risk), C) post-process billing events and remap by error kind (accounting smell).

marta: prefer B. lightweight and reversible. also add a short-term shim: if validator emits invalid_function_output and no route-hint, tag billing.route = /fncall before emitting billing event. behind ff.

tia: agreed. i'll open PR that: 1) populates x-route-hint in auth middleware from the route table, 2) updates validator to prefer header when tagging errors, 3) adds fallback shim behind ff 'route-preserve-validate'. will include unit+e2e and a migration script stub.

noah: also include telemetry change: attach route_hint to validation error payload so downstream processors have extra context for remap/backfill. makes reconciliation safer.

observability-bot: FYI — any change must be feature-flagged and canaried. Recommended canary: 5% first, expand to 25% after 6h if no regressions. Add dashboard to monitor mislabel rate and billing-route churn.

billing-team: we need a list of impacted reqs to reconcile chargeback for the dedicated customer. Ops, can you run a dry-run?

observability-bot: dry-run query: 2026-03-13T00:00 -> 2026-03-14T18:00 UTC, predicate "validation.error_kind:invalid_function_output AND billing.route:'/chat.generate'" => 112 matches. CSV exported to ops:/tmp/fncall-mislabels-112.csv (dry-run).

marta: ok. tia, target timeline?

tia: PR today, canary tomorrow morning 5% hosted+dedi, monitor 12h, backfill dry-run then coordinate with billing to patch history if safe.

noah: great. once PR is open i'll review. marta, i'll draft a short support KB explaining the reconciliation plan and short FAQ for affected customers.

marta: thanks. small follow-up: also include a test that simulates streaming request where route-resolve would normally run late so we don't regress.

tia: will add integration. closing loop when PR merges. :thumbsup:
